+"""Tests for the structural human-in-the-loop / conjunctive invariants on Finding.
+
+These exist because the lead/verdict line is supposed to be load-bearing in the
+DATA MODEL, not just the docs. A Finding that asserts wrongdoing, drops the
+disclaimer, or rests on a single source must be impossible to construct.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from datetime import date
+
+import pytest
+from pydantic import ValidationError
+
+from coi.models import DISCLAIMER, Finding, RecordSource, ReviewPriority
+
+
+def _base_kwargs(**overrides):
+    kw = dict(
+        finding_id="F1",
+        approver_entity_id="E1",
+        approver_name="A",
+        awardee_entity_id="E2",
+        awardee_name="B",
+        award_id="AW",
+        program="P",
+        award_date=date(2025, 1, 1),
+        conflict_links=[],
+        evidence=[],
+        distinct_sources=[RecordSource.GRANT_RECORDS, RecordSource.DEEDS],
+        review_priority=ReviewPriority.HIGH,
+        narrative="LEAD FOR HUMAN REVIEW - not a determination.",
+        disclaimer=DISCLAIMER,
+    )
+    kw.update(overrides)
+    return kw
+
+
+def test_valid_finding_constructs():
+    f = Finding(**_base_kwargs())
+    assert f.status.value == "unreviewed_lead"
+    assert f.requires_human_review is True
+    assert f.is_determination is False
+
+
+def test_rejects_requires_human_review_false():
+    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
+        Finding(**_base_kwargs(requires_human_review=False))
+
+
+def test_rejects_is_determination_true():
+    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
+        Finding(**_base_kwargs(is_determination=True))
+
+
+def test_rejects_missing_disclaimer():
+    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
+        Finding(**_base_kwargs(disclaimer=""))
+
+
+def test_rejects_disclaimer_without_caveat():
+    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
+        Finding(**_base_kwargs(disclaimer="This person is guilty."))
+
+
+def test_rejects_accusatory_narrative():
+    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
+        Finding(**_base_kwargs(narrative="A took a bribe and is corrupt."))
+
+
+def test_rejects_single_source_finding():
+    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
+        Finding(**_base_kwargs(distinct_sources=[RecordSource.GRANT_RECORDS]))
